turns.question: What was the median order amount in EUR for non-cancelled orders placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median order value metric, so I cannot give a median. The closest metric is Average order value (EUR), which was 114.39 EUR across non-cancelled orders placed 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, and it is an average, not a median. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
